name: Execute a SQL query
query:
SELECT
    u.id,
    u.name,
    u.email,

    u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
    s.name AS "sectorName",

    u.active,
    u.is_master AS "isMaster",

    CASE
        WHEN u.is_master = TRUE THEN (
            SELECT COALESCE(
                json_agg(
                    p_all.code
                    ORDER BY p_all.name
                ),
                '[]'::json
            )
            FROM permissions p_all
            WHERE p_all.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
        )
        ELSE COALESCE(
            json_agg(
                DISTINCT p.code
                ORDER BY p.code
            ) FILTER (
                WHERE p.code IS NOT NULL
                  AND p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
            ),
            '[]'::json
        )
    END AS permissions,

    u.created_at AS "createdAt",
    u.updated_at AS "updatedAt"

FROM users u

LEFT JOIN sectors s
    ON s.id = u.sector_id

LEFT JOIN user_permissions up
    ON up.user_id = u.id

LEFT JOIN permissions p
    ON p.id = up.permission_id

GROUP BY
    u.id,
    u.name,
    u.email,
    u.sector_id,
    s.name,
    u.active,
    u.is_master,
    u.created_at,
    u.updated_at

ORDER BY
    u.name ASC;
